correct_query: SELECT "holder_name" FROM (SELECT * FROM "account" AS "LHS" WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT "account_id", "status", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "dispatch_log" GROUP BY "account_id", "status") WHERE ("status" = 'Sent' AND n >= 2)) AS RHS WHERE (LHS.account_id = RHS.account_id))) ORDER BY holder_name

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant flattens EXISTS grouped count subquery into JOIN + GROUP BY + HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 and omits ORDER BY holder_name
